ios.desc:
Stop guessing. Start playing GTO.

Poker Solver+ gives you instant access to professionally solved GTO strategies for every spot you face at the table — preflop through river, cash games and tournaments, across multiple stack depths. No complex setup. No expensive desktop software. Just tap, enter your hand, and see the optimal play in seconds.

Whether you're reviewing a tough hand after a session, prepping for a big tournament, or studying spots during downtime, Solver+ puts a complete GTO engine in your pocket.

WHY SERIOUS PLAYERS CHOOSE SOLVER+

• Instant GTO Solutions — Enter any hole cards, any board, any line. See exact frequencies, bet sizings, and EVs for every decision point from flop to river. Results in seconds, not hours.

• Complete Preflop + Postflop Coverage — The only app that combines full preflop opening ranges with deep postflop solver output. See the complete picture from open to showdown.

• Quick Line Checker — Played a hand and not sure if you made the right call? Replay your line and instantly see how it compares to GTO. Perfect for post-session review.

• Range Splits & EV Visualization — See how ranges narrow street by street. View equity and EV distributions from both IP and OOP perspectives. Tap any combo for detailed breakdowns.

• Cash Games & Tournaments — 6-max cash (multiple stack sizes), MTT, and more formats solved and ready. New spots and solves added regularly.

• Works on iPhone, iPad & Mac — Study at your desk or on the go. Your solver is always with you.

WHO IS SOLVER+ FOR?

→ Cash game grinders who want to verify their lines match GTO and identify leaks costing them money.
→ Tournament players prepping for WSOP, WPT, or online MTTs who need to study ICM-aware spots quickly.
→ Poker coaches and study groups who want a shared reference for analyzing hands together.
→ Anyone upgrading from basic preflop charts who is ready for deep, street-by-street GTO strategy.

ThinkGTO builds the world's most popular mobile GTO poker training suite — trusted by over 15,000 active players across Solver+, Postflop+, Preflop+, and GTO Ranges+.

Download free and explore with limited access. Upgrade to unlock the full solver library.

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS

Solver+ offers two auto-renewing subscription options:
$19.99 per month
$199.99 per year

These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
